title: rigor: mathematical consistency audit
description: Perform an audit to ensure that identical requirements produce the same quality score in both Discovery (Answer-based) and Planning (Spec-based) phases.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain score parity across workflow phases.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return identical scores for both Answer and Spec evaluators.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the audit to pass

preconditions: Lattice and Intent scoring implementations are active
invariants: The math engine uses the same weights and thresholds in all phases

title: rigor: e2e test discovery to planning
description: Implement a full Playwright E2E test that covers the journey from initial Express input to bead generation.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL support the complete user journey without error.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL navigate through Discovery, gating, and Planning.

unwanted.condition: IF a UI element blocks the flow
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT hide the failure in logs
unwanted.because: automated validation is the final gate for release.

postconditions: Test creates valid beads in the database
invariants: The test environment is cleaned up after each run

title: rigor: security audit auth and validation
description: Perform a security audit of the quality engine to verify that it correctly identifies and weights authentication, encryption, and validation requirements.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL prioritize security-critical requirements.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL assign maximum weight to the Security dimension.

unwanted.condition: IF a security requirement is missed
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow a high overall score
unwanted.because: security is a primary quality dimension.

preconditions: Security keyword list is defined in domain
postconditions: Audit verifies 100% detection rate for known security patterns
invariants: No security bypass exists in the scoring algebra
